_meta.purpose: Generator parameters for the fictional demo company (robust inputs, full P&L). Every parameter has a source. BEST GUESS = the author's estimate, to be replaced with official data (Eurostat NACE 47.61/47.62/47.65, ECB, Slovak tax authority).
_meta.company: Papiernictvo DEMO s.r.o. — fictional chain of 4 stores + head office; does not resemble any real company

period._source: last year 2025 in full, current year 2026 to September; full-year forecast = Oct–Dec 2026

_cost_centers_source: BEST GUESS — small chain: revenue of €1,100–2,900 incl. VAT per day per store (~€2 million a year excl. VAT), 14 employees; staff ~17% of revenue, EBITDA ~9% (typical for small specialised retail — to be verified)
_categories_source: BEST GUESS — share = share of REVENUE (value), not of receipt lines: stationery 45%, books 20%, toys 20%, gifts 15%; Slovak VAT from 2025-01-01: standard rate 23%, books 5% (VAT Act, public); margin and item price are an industry estimate
_closed_days_source: Slovak public holidays and non-working days 2025–2026 (public), days when retail is closed

pos._source: BEST GUESS — 1–3 items per receipt; 2/3 of payments by card; card fee 1.1%

stock._source: BEST GUESS — stock of ~1.4 months of sales at cost; purchasing weekly

payroll._source: BEST GUESS for pay; Slovak contributions 2025: employer 36.2%, employee 14.4% (health insurance +1 pp from 2025-01-01, consolidation package — to be verified against official sources); tax 19%, tax-free allowance ~€497 a month

services._source: BEST GUESS — rent by location, energy with seasonality, IT and accounting outsourced

fixed_assets._source: BEST GUESS — store fittings and IT, straight-line depreciation

loan._source: BEST GUESS — head-office investment loan, 5.2% p.a.

income_tax._source: Slovak corporate income tax 2025: 21% (revenue of €5 million or less, above €100,000) — public

plan_2026._source: BEST GUESS — management plans revenue +8% on 2025, evenly; costs as in 2025 + contracts

S1_rent_jump.what: The shopping centre raised the rent from April 2026 and it is not in the plan — Store OC EBITDA below plan

S2_toys_decline.what: Toys fall three quarters of 2026 in a row — revenue below plan, a risk for Christmas (full-year forecast)

S3_energy_spike.what: Winter energy price 2026 +35% against the contract — a one-off variance

S4_school_boost.what: Back to school 2026 above plan — an opportunity if it holds in Q4 (exercise books, calendars)

E1.what: supplier invoice in the invoice register but not posted in the journal

E2.what: an employee's pay in the payroll export differs from the books (521)

E3.what: bank payment without an invoice in the invoice register

E4.what: stock issue without stock — negative balance

E5.what: trial balance adjusted by hand — does not tie to the journal

E6.what: POS export truncated — the TOTAL row does not tie to the sum of receipts

E7.what: one day's card payment settlement is missing in the bank

opening._source: BEST GUESS — balance sheet as at 2024-12-31: share capital €5,000, retained earnings = balancing figure, trade payables for December 2024 due in January

dividend._source: BEST GUESS — dividend paid to the shareholder out of retained earnings (7% withholding tax left out for simplicity)
